name: Linux runtime (Debian 13 (trixie))
note: Debian 13 (trixie) arm64 runtime for DroidHost, built by tools/debian in linuszz/DroidHost (97c13d462e6fbd304941dc41c5ba4eab42e6052a). Its KDE Plasma desktop pack is droidhost-debian13-arm64-r1-desktop.tar.zst in the same release, named inside the runtime at usr/share/droiddeck/desktop-pack.json.
